cases.refreshed: Want to grow in understanding basic math concepts and working on basic competitive math skills? Join us in Santa Teresa Junior Math Club and see your math and problem-solving skills improve! Concepts covered include rounding, solving with fractions, area, perimeter, data and graphs, money, polygons, angles, and decimals. For children in 3rd through 5th grade (geared towards ages 8-11 years old). Free. Walk-ins welcome until program participant capacity is reached. Sessions are not related, so you can join any time! This program meets every other Monday from 8/24 - 11/30 from 4:15 PM-5:15 PM in the Santa Teresa Library Community Room or Group Study Room A, depending on the week. Please see the sign by the entrance for program location. It is led by a teen volunteer. Come join the fun and watch your math skills grow!

cases.refreshed: Our One-on-One Reading Tutor for Kids provides students in grades K-3 with an opportunity to improve their reading skills by working one-on-one with a reading coach. Our reading coach creates a positive reading experience for beginning and developing readers and helps children build confidence as readers. Our reading coach will listen to children read and provide support in phonics, sight words, and comprehension. Students can bring their favorite book or choose from the available selection at the Cambrian Branch Library to read aloud to their reading coach. Free. No advance registration is required. Sessions last 15 minutes and are available on a first-come, first-served basis. (A slightly longer session may be permitted, provided there are no other participants.) If you'd like to use your reading session to reduce your library fines, tell your coach. This option is open to youth only. Please note that the One-On-One Reading Tutor for Kids is a program to encourage young readers to practice their reading skills with an adult volunteer. (It is not intended as an hour-long tutoring session.)

cases.refreshed: Need help with 3D printing or looking for guided, hands-on experience? This session is ideal for beginners seeking practical experience, guided support, and confidence in using 3D printing technology. This is also a good opportunity for those who attended our 3D Design & Printing workshop and now want to try their hands at it. Participants will have the opportunity to print a simple model under supervision. If you do not have a design, you may choose a free design from Thingiverse or a similar site. All designs are printed in a single color of PLA - filament color is at the discretion of the program lead. Designs must print in 1 hour 45 minutes - if you're not sure how long your design will take to print, email cz.sjpl@sjlibrary.org. All designs must be compatible with the Creality K1C printer. Final approval of printability will be determined by the program lead. SJPL reserves the right to refuse any print request. One appointment per month per person.
